title: SPDD UI Design Proposal Draft Output
description: Producer output contract for the SPDD UI design proposal draft gate before architecture.

outcome.description: Producer must use ready_for_attack for an initial or critic-requested proposal and ready_for_approval for a correction requested at the user gate. Missing help is reported through the runner non-blocking stop control channel, never as an output outcome.
outcome.x-usage: Treat this as the authoritative workflow state for completed output. Do not infer success from other populated fields when it requires revision.

summary.description: Producer must summarize the UI design proposal state for human approval without embedding the ui-design-proposal artifact body.
summary.x-usage: Use this as the human-facing approval state for the UI design proposal gate. Show it with the artifact attachment; do not recreate the summary from artifact contents in the orchestrator.

artifacts.description: Producer must emit the required immutable, self-contained ui-design-proposal HTML artifact plus one derived PNG reference capture for each REASONS view.
artifacts.x-usage: For both ready_for_attack and ready_for_approval, emit ui-design-proposal with content_type text/html first, followed by the seven stable image/png capture ids in REASONS order. Build every proposed surface in HTML/CSS first; the PNGs must be deterministic browser screenshots of that final HTML, never independently generated designs.

results.description: Producer may emit compact structured results, decisions, or evidence summaries created by this stage.
results.x-usage: Use these as supporting evidence or compact summaries. Do not let them override outcome, selected steps, or approved contracts.
